zh-CN.headlineFact: 决赛将至，世界在加速与承压之间摆动
zh-CN.headlineView: 扩张速度正在撞上资源、信任与治理边界。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 决赛将至，世界在加速与承压之间摆动；扩张速度正在撞上资源、信任与治理边界。
zh-CN.intro: 世界杯决赛将至；AI数据中心遭遇抗议，一人公司增长。美伊冲突、印度民营火箭、加拿大山火、埃博拉应对与一英里纪录，呈现扩张与治理的拉扯。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 扩张速度正在撞上资源、信任与治理边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 世界一边紧张，一边继续向前跑。

en-US.headlineFact: The final approaches as the world swings between acceleration and pressure
en-US.headlineView: Expansion is colliding with limits of resources, trust and governance.
en-US.headlineFull: The final approaches as the world swings between acceleration and pressure; Expansion is colliding with limits of resources, trust and governance.
en-US.intro: The World Cup final nears. AI data-center protests and solo founding grow, while U.S.-Iran fighting, India’s private orbital launch, Canadian wildfires, Ebola response and a mile record expose tension between expansion and governance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Expansion is colliding with limits of resources, trust and governance.
en-US.doudouQuote: The world is tense, but it keeps moving forward.

sources.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 match schedule, fixtures and results

zh-CN.headlineFact: 窗口内无完赛；季军战截止时刚开球，决赛即将上演
zh-CN.headlineView: 窗口规则比“今天有球”更重要，边界必须一致。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 窗口内无完赛；季军战截止时刚开球，决赛即将上演；窗口规则比“今天有球”更重要，边界必须一致。
zh-CN.intro: 北京时间7月18日05:00至19日05:00无完赛。法国对英格兰于截止时开球，不计入本期；西班牙对阿根廷决赛将于20日03:00进行。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 窗口规则比“今天有球”更重要，边界必须一致。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 哨响在截止线上，下一期再算比分。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：世界杯日报。

en-US.headlineFact: No match finished in the window; third-place play began at the cutoff
en-US.headlineView: A fixed reporting window matters more than saying there was a match today.
en-US.headlineFull: No match finished in the window; third-place play began at the cutoff; A fixed reporting window matters more than saying there was a match today.
en-US.intro: No match finished from 05:00 Jul 18 to 05:00 Jul 19 Beijing time. France vs England kicked off at the cutoff and is excluded. Spain vs Argentina starts at 03:00 Jul 20.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A fixed reporting window matters more than saying there was a match today.
en-US.doudouQuote: The whistle came at the cutoff; score it next issue.

sources.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 match schedule, fixtures and results

zh-CN.headlineFact: 全美至少125地抗议AI数据中心；算力扩张撞上社区边界
zh-CN.headlineView: AI竞争也要回答谁承担电力、水与环境成本。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 全美至少125地抗议AI数据中心；算力扩张撞上社区边界；AI竞争也要回答谁承担电力、水与环境成本。
zh-CN.intro: 路透社称抗议覆盖至少125地。6月Reuters/Ipsos调查仅14%支持在本社区建AI数据中心，争议集中于电费、水与污染。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI竞争也要回答谁承担电力、水与环境成本。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 云端很轻，落地却是电站、水管和账单。

en-US.headlineFact: AI data centers face protests in at least 125 U.S. locations
en-US.headlineView: AI competition must answer who pays the power, water and environmental costs.
en-US.headlineFull: AI data centers face protests in at least 125 U.S. locations; AI competition must answer who pays the power, water and environmental costs.
en-US.intro: Reuters reports protests in at least 125 locations. A June Reuters/Ipsos poll found only 14% support an AI data center in their own community, amid power, water and pollution concerns.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI competition must answer who pays the power, water and environmental costs.
en-US.doudouQuote: The cloud feels light; on the ground it is plants, pipes and bills.

sources.title: US data center protests go national as backlash grows

zh-CN.headlineFact: Stripe Atlas新设公司63%由独立创始人创建；AI降低门槛却不替代验证
zh-CN.headlineView: AI降低开工门槛，却不替代需求验证、分销、信任与复购。
zh-CN.headlineFull: Stripe Atlas新设公司63%由独立创始人创建；AI降低门槛却不替代验证；AI降低开工门槛，却不替代需求验证、分销、信任与复购。
zh-CN.intro: Stripe称2026年二季度迄今63% Atlas C类公司由单人创办；AI原生一人公司两年收入接近其他样本两倍。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI降低开工门槛，却不替代需求验证、分销、信任与复购。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一个人可以先出发，但别拒绝协作。

en-US.headlineFact: 63% of new Stripe Atlas companies have solo founders
en-US.headlineView: AI lowers the starting barrier, but not the need for validation, distribution, trust and retention.
en-US.headlineFull: 63% of new Stripe Atlas companies have solo founders; AI lowers the starting barrier, but not the need for validation, distribution, trust and retention.
en-US.intro: Stripe says 63% of Atlas C corporations created so far in Q2 2026 are solo-founded. AI-native solo startups approach twice the two-year revenue of other samples.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI lowers the starting barrier, but not the need for validation, distribution, trust and retention.
en-US.doudouQuote: One person can start the journey; collaboration still matters.

sources.title: Solo founding is at an all-time high

zh-CN.headlineFact: 伊朗袭击致两名美军在约旦死亡；升级时更要分清事实与说法
zh-CN.headlineView: 冲突升级时，要分开已证实事实、单方说法与推测。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 伊朗袭击致两名美军在约旦死亡；升级时更要分清事实与说法；冲突升级时，要分开已证实事实、单方说法与推测。
zh-CN.intro: 美军称两人死亡、一人失踪；美方随后扩大空袭。伊朗方面另有多项战果说法，部分尚未独立核实。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 冲突升级时，要分开已证实事实、单方说法与推测。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 看到“某方称”，先别自动改成“事情就是这样”。

en-US.headlineFact: Iranian strike kills two U.S. troops in Jordan
en-US.headlineView: In escalation, separate confirmed facts, one-sided claims and inference.
en-US.headlineFull: Iranian strike kills two U.S. troops in Jordan; In escalation, separate confirmed facts, one-sided claims and inference.
en-US.intro: The U.S. military says two troops died and one is missing; Washington then expanded airstrikes. Iran made additional claims, some not independently verified.
en-US.xiaziQuote: In escalation, separate confirmed facts, one-sided claims and inference.
en-US.doudouQuote: When a report says one side claims, do not turn it into certainty.

sources.title: US military personnel killed in Iranian attacks on Jordan

zh-CN.headlineFact: 印度首枚民营轨道火箭Vikram-1入轨；商业航天迈过关键门槛
zh-CN.headlineView: 民营航天的价值，不只是一枚火箭，而是更灵活的发射供给。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 印度首枚民营轨道火箭Vikram-1入轨；商业航天迈过关键门槛；民营航天的价值，不只是一枚火箭，而是更灵活的发射供给。
zh-CN.intro: ISRO确认，Skyroot的Vikram-1于7月18日从斯里哈里科塔升空，成为印度首枚民营轨道运载火箭，并将载荷送入约450公里轨道。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 民营航天的价值，不只是一枚火箭，而是更灵活的发射供给。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 从“能造”到“能入轨”，这一步真的飞起来了。

en-US.headlineFact: India’s first private orbital rocket Vikram-1 reaches orbit
en-US.headlineView: Private spaceflight expands flexible launch supply.
en-US.headlineFull: India’s first private orbital rocket Vikram-1 reaches orbit; Private spaceflight expands flexible launch supply.
en-US.intro: ISRO confirms Skyroot’s Vikram-1 launched from Sriharikota on July 18, becoming India’s first privately built orbital launcher and placing payloads near 450 km.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Private spaceflight expands flexible launch supply.
en-US.doudouQuote: From can build to can orbit—this one truly flew.

sources.title: First private orbital launch lifts off from Sriharikota

zh-CN.headlineFact: 加拿大7月仍有796处山火活跃；跨区域烟霾再次提醒气候风险
zh-CN.headlineView: 烟雾越过边界时，环境风险从来不是单一国家的内部事务。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 加拿大7月仍有796处山火活跃；跨区域烟霾再次提醒气候风险；烟雾越过边界时，环境风险从来不是单一国家的内部事务。
zh-CN.intro: 加拿大政府7月更新称全国有796处活跃山火，其中60处失控；北部与安大略、魁北克部分地区风险仍高。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 烟雾越过边界时，环境风险从来不是单一国家的内部事务。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 风不会查护照，烟也不会在边境线停下。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与环境。

en-US.headlineFact: Canada still has 796 active wildfires in July
en-US.headlineView: When smoke crosses borders, environmental risk is never one country’s internal affair.
en-US.headlineFull: Canada still has 796 active wildfires in July; When smoke crosses borders, environmental risk is never one country’s internal affair.
en-US.intro: Canada’s July update reports 796 active wildfires nationwide, including 60 out of control. Risks remain high in the north and parts of Ontario and Quebec.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When smoke crosses borders, environmental risk is never one country’s internal affair.
en-US.doudouQuote: Wind checks no passport; smoke does not stop at a border.

sources.title: The Government of Canada provides an update regarding the 2026 wildfire season

zh-CN.headlineFact: WHO确认本迪布焦型埃博拉仍在外溢；防控依赖医学也依赖一线安全
zh-CN.headlineView: 防控依赖医学，也依赖信任、安全和一线人员持续工作。
zh-CN.headlineFull: WHO确认本迪布焦型埃博拉仍在外溢；防控依赖医学也依赖一线安全；防控依赖医学，也依赖信任、安全和一线人员持续工作。
zh-CN.intro: WHO称截至7月14日累计20例确认病例，含两例输入性死亡，另有一例疑似死亡；一名美国援助人员被转运德国治疗。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 防控依赖医学，也依赖信任、安全和一线人员持续工作。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 防护服能挡病毒，却挡不住薄弱的防控系统。

en-US.headlineFact: WHO confirms continued spillover of Bundibugyo Ebola
en-US.headlineView: Control depends on medicine, trust, safety and sustained frontline work.
en-US.headlineFull: WHO confirms continued spillover of Bundibugyo Ebola; Control depends on medicine, trust, safety and sustained frontline work.
en-US.intro: WHO reports 20 confirmed cases through July 14, including two deaths in imported cases and one probable death. A U.S. aid worker was transferred to Germany for treatment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Control depends on medicine, trust, safety and sustained frontline work.
en-US.doudouQuote: Protective suits can block a virus, not a fragile response system.

sources.title: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus, Democratic Republic of the Congo & Uganda

zh-CN.headlineFact: 乔什·科尔3分42秒66打破27年一英里纪录；多年训练终于越线
zh-CN.headlineView: 纪录被打破的瞬间，背后是多年训练、节奏与信念。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 乔什·科尔3分42秒66打破27年一英里纪录；多年训练终于越线；纪录被打破的瞬间，背后是多年训练、节奏与信念。
zh-CN.intro: 世界田联确认，英国选手乔什·科尔7月18日在伦敦跑出3分42秒66，刷新希沙姆·埃尔·盖鲁伊1999年的3分43秒13纪录。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 纪录被打破的瞬间，背后是多年训练、节奏与信念。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 27年的墙倒下，只用了不到四分钟。

en-US.headlineFact: Josh Kerr runs 3:42.66 to break the 27-year mile record
en-US.headlineView: A record falls in a moment; behind it stand years of training, rhythm and belief.
en-US.headlineFull: Josh Kerr runs 3:42.66 to break the 27-year mile record; A record falls in a moment; behind it stand years of training, rhythm and belief.
en-US.intro: World Athletics confirms Britain’s Josh Kerr ran 3:42.66 in London on July 18, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj’s 1999 mark of 3:43.13.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A record falls in a moment; behind it stand years of training, rhythm and belief.
en-US.doudouQuote: A 27-year wall fell in under four minutes.

sources.title: Kerr breaks world mile record with 3:42.66 in London
